name: email-draft-save
description: Save an email as a draft without sending it, in one of Curia's own mailboxes, which the principal does not see; mailbox in the result says where it went. to takes a contact ID, or "principal"; the address comes from their verified identities.

inputs.to: string (contact ID or "principal", optional #label hint such as principal#personal — a hint, not an address. Not a contact yet: contact-create first)
inputs.subject: string (email subject line)
inputs.body: string (email body; markdown supported, converted to HTML automatically. Except in the principal's own mailbox, the signature is added automatically, so end with the message itself: a valediction such as "Best," at most, never a name, title or signature)
inputs.account: string? (named account to draft from, as configured under Settings → Channels → Email → Email accounts. Defaults to the primary account.)
inputs.reply_to_message_id: string? (Nylas message ID to reply to; threads the draft as a reply when set)
inputs.attachments: object[]? (file attachments — array of {file_url: string, filename: string, content_type: string, node_id?: string}. file_url must be a file:// URL from email-download-attachment or similar. When the attachment contains KG-sourced data, set node_id to the kg_nodes UUID so export gates can resolve sensitivity. Max 10 attachments, 20 MB total.)
inputs.export_items: object[]? (parallel to attachments — array of {node_id: string, label: string} tagging each attachment's KG source for bulk-export gates.)

outputs.mailbox: string ("curia", unseen by the principal; "principal" only for an account bound to their address)
outputs.to_identity: string (label of the address used, or "primary" or "unlabelled")
outputs.contact_id: string? (when to was a contact ID)
